description:
A neat little application that allows you to draw on your screen

iScribby is a screen-drawing application: use it anywhere — on your desktop, while browsing the internet, or even in a video game — to draw, highlight, and annotate directly on the screen during presentations, streams, and lessons.
- Added the ability to edit text using text tool by clicking on the object.
- Added the ability to edit text using cursor tool by doing a double click on a text object.
- Clicking on the tray icon will now launch the control panel.
- Fix - app crashing when it’s unable to parse the loaded in color value.
- Added a welcome tab on to the control panel.
